data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display live metrics such as LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown using a line chart
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized using an area chart

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using an 8-stage pipeline chart
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts
Success rates are shown using area charts

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight key features of Artemis, including cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning, using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Cost tracking is clearly demonstrated with charts
Sandboxing and learning features are visually represented
Charts accurately reflect the features being showcased

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data
Chart is interactive and visually appealing
Integration across stages is clearly communicated

features.title: Display Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Show actual data from recent runs to demonstrate the effectiveness of Artemis.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are accurately displayed
Data is up-to-date and relevant
Charts effectively communicate the results

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis self-demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file
Chart.js is included for data visualization

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set time interval
Users can manually navigate between slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart accurately reflects code quality metrics
TDD compliance and SOLID principles are clearly shown
Chart is interactive and easy to understand

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions into the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is visually appealing and consistent
Transitions between slides are smooth
Overall design is professional and polished
